change: in-app updater for the github release channel, two build flavours

covers: manifest parsing of untrusted documents: wrong types, unknown and duplicate ABIs, non-repository download addresses, oversized input
every trust refusal: foreign package, downgrade, replay, older version name, foreign certificate digest, low API level, missing architecture
downloaded APK checks: size, checksum, package, version code, single signer, signer equalling the installed app, native architectures
version-name ordering across the four-level policy
downloader against a local socket server: redirect following, monotonic progress, oversized response, connection dying mid-file

the two pacing rules (fifteen-minute floor for every request, six-hour interval for the app's own check, failed attempts never starting the interval, a corrected clock treated as expired), the minutes reported to the user, and banner dismissal hiding only the notice for that release

release_tools.note: includes the manifest generator's schema, URLs and rejection cases, the recipe's flavour selection per tag (asserting at least one tag was read), and the fdroid recipe block for new releases

pacing.every_request: at least fifteen minutes since the previous attempt, recorded before the request so a failed fetch or parse counts
pacing.app_initiated: at most once every six hours, measured from the last successful answer, so a failed attempt never spends that interval
pacing.user_initiated: gated by the fifteen-minute floor only

fdroid.updater_code: none of the classes tools/check_release.py looks for appears in any dex: GithubUpdater, ReleaseFetch, ReleaseManifestParser, PackageInstalls, UpdateInstallReceiver, CheckThrottle, UpdatePrefs, InstallResults, Apks, UpdatePolicy, ReleaseManifest, UpdateState, UpdateApi, UpdateUi. The whole app/src/github source set is excluded from this build, so the absence follows from the build graph as well as from this scan; the scan is what would catch a class drifting into shared code.

structure: every updater source file lives in app/src/github; app/src/main names no update type, calling three flavour-provided composables instead; INTERNET appears only in app/src/github/AndroidManifest.xml
recipe: a build block may select the fdroid flavour only when the tag it pins defines the flavours; tools/check_release.py reads app/build.gradle.kts at each tag and android.yml now fetches tags so the rule is checked rather than skipped
not_verified: PackageInstaller install path on a device or emulator: this machine has no /dev/kvm
STATUS_PENDING_USER_ACTION confirmation dialog and the post-install restart
a download of a real published release from GitHub (tests use a local HTTP server)
behaviour behind captive portals, proxies or per-OEM installer prompts
the settings row and floating banner rendered on a screen; no emulator is available
the installer-outcome plumbing and the foreground reconciliation: Android-bound, not unit-tested
